summary: Push day. Breakfast leans into the Ginger Mango Protein Smoothie he's grabbed for himself the last two mornings instead of fighting it, paired with quick turkey/bagel/berries so it's still fast to grab. Lunch brings in Mary's Soy Sauce Roasted Chicken for variety after three straight days of the same chicken mains, and dinner uses the Garlic Chile Cumin Roasted Chicken thigh for a heartier post-workout plate.
